map.锻炼短期记忆力，挑战你的数字记忆极限: Exercise your short-term memory and push your number span to the limit
map.📖 查看「数字记忆测试使用指南」: 📖 View the "Number Memory Test User Guide"
map.数字记忆按序列长度递进：正确率 = 正确位数 ÷ 总位数 × 100%；起始长度: Digit sequences grow by length: accuracy = correct digits ÷ total digits × 100%; the starting length is usually 3 to 5 digits, going up by 1 when everything is right and holding or dropping by 1 after an error; memory span = the largest length cleared in a row, and a normal adult short-term digit span is about 7 ± 2 items; reaction time = submit moment − display moment.
map.：将长数字分成3-4位一组记忆，如手机号分成3-4-4格式: : split a long number into groups of 3-4 digits, the way a phone number is written 3-4-4
map.：用数字谐音编故事，如\"14\"谐音\"钥匙\": : build a story from how the numbers sound, for example 14 sounds like "key"
map.：将每个数字转化为具体图像，形成记忆宫殿: : turn each digit into a concrete image and build a memory palace
: 0 looks like an egg, 1 like a pencil, 2 like a duck, 3 like an ear...
map.：短期记忆容量约7±2个组块，训练可以提升: : short-term memory holds about 7±2 chunks and training widens it
map.📚 深度解析：依次闪现数字序列要求复述，逐步加长以训练短时记忆广度。: 📚 In-depth: flashes up digit sequences to repeat, gradually lengthening them to train short-term memory span.
map.序列闪现：短时呈现数字。: Sequence flash: digits shown for a moment.
map.长度递增：逐轮加长。: Increasing length: one more each round.
map.成绩记录：追踪最高长度。: Score log: tracks your best length.
map.示例：闪现 7-3-9-1，复述正确则加长。: Example: 7-3-9-1 flashes up; recall it correctly and the sequence gets longer.
map.训练工作记忆广度，类似数字广度测验。: It trains working memory span, much like a digit span test.
map.每轮递增位数挑战更大。: Each round adds another digit, raising the challenge.
